/.title: RAGGuard: know when your RAG index is wrong, before your users do
/.description: RAGGuard checks that a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) index matches its source documents. It compares the files in Amazon S3 with a Qdrant or pgvector index, and optionally the ingestion pipeline's own records, and reports missing, stale, half-indexed, duplicate, empty, deleted-but-still-searchable and wrong-tenant chunks, with the evidence and a safe fix. It only reads your systems. Free during the beta.

/guides.title: Guides: keep your RAG index in sync with your source documents · RAGGuard
/guides.description: Eight silent ways a RAG index drifts away from its source documents, with a copy-paste check for each: SQL for pgvector, and the same idea for Qdrant.

/guides/catch-chunks-tagged-with-the-wro.title: Catch chunks tagged with the wrong tenant · RAGGuard
/guides/catch-chunks-tagged-with-the-wro.description: In a multi-tenant RAG app, one chunk with the wrong tenant tag can show one customer's content to another. Compare every chunk's tenant with its source file's tenant.

/guides/detect-stale-embeddings-after-a-.title: Detect stale embeddings after a document changes · RAGGuard
/guides/detect-stale-embeddings-after-a-.description: When a source file changes but its chunks do not, your RAG app keeps answering from the old version. Store the file's hash on every chunk and compare.

/guides/find-documents-missing-from-your.title: Find documents missing from your vector index · RAGGuard
/guides/find-documents-missing-from-your.description: A file can sit in your bucket while nothing about it is searchable. Compare the documents in storage with the documents in your index to find them.

/guides/find-documents-with-two-versions.title: Find documents with two versions in the index · RAGGuard
/guides/find-documents-with-two-versions.description: The new version of a document was indexed, but the old chunks were never deleted, so both versions answer questions. Count the distinct versions per document.

/guides/find-duplicate-chunks-from-retri.title: Find duplicate chunks from retried ingestion · RAGGuard
/guides/find-duplicate-chunks-from-retri.description: A retried ingestion job can write the same chunk twice. Duplicates crowd other content out of the top results and skew answers. Group by document and position to find them.

/guides/find-empty-or-all-zero-vectors.title: Find empty or all-zero vectors · RAGGuard
/guides/find-empty-or-all-zero-vectors.description: A failed embedding call can leave a chunk with no vector or a vector of zeros. Such a chunk can never be found by search. Check the vector's length.

/guides/find-half-indexed-documents.title: Find half-indexed documents · RAGGuard
/guides/find-half-indexed-documents.description: An ingestion worker can die after writing only some of a document's chunks. Store the expected chunk count on every chunk and look for gaps.

/guides/make-sure-deleted-documents-are-.title: Make sure deleted documents are not still searchable · RAGGuard
/guides/make-sure-deleted-documents-are-.description: Deleting a file from storage does not delete its vectors. Find chunks whose source file no longer exists, then prove whether a search can still return them.

/guides/use-ragguard-from-your-ai-assist.title: Use RAGGuard from your AI assistant · RAGGuard
/guides/use-ragguard-from-your-ai-assist.description: Let Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or any MCP-capable assistant check your RAG index for you: a rule to paste into your project, an MCP server, and a command your assistant can run.
